name: comp-264
title: Object Position Slider
blurb: Dual-axis slider for selecting X and Y position on a 2D plane.
description: A 2D slider allowing independent X and Y value selection via dragging, useful for object positioning.
use_when: Setting 2D coordinates, positions, or alignment values.
avoid_when: Simple 1D ranges or when axis confusion would occur.
a11y: Keyboard navigation of a 2D slider is complex. Arrow keys may control one axis.
